user.title: Connect to Prometheus
user.description: Enter the connection settings and press **Test connection**. You will be able to review the result before saving.

data_description.prometheus_url: Base URL of Prometheus or a compatible API (VictoriaMetrics, Thanos, Mimir), e.g. http://192.168.1.100:9090
data_description.name: A friendly name for this server, shown in the card editor

test_result.title: Connection successful
test_result.description:
✅ Connected to **{url}**

- Version: **{version}**
- Response time: **{latency} ms**
- Targets up: **{targets}**

reconfigure.description: Change the connection settings and press **Test connection**.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the server: {error_detail}
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed ({error_detail}). Check the username and password.
error.timeout: The server did not respond in time ({error_detail}).
error.ssl_error: SSL error: {error_detail}. Disable "Verify SSL certificate" for self-signed certificates.
error.not_prometheus: The URL does not look like a Prometheus API ({error_detail}). Use the base URL without /graph or /api.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Prometheus server is already configured.

init.title: Prometheus Dashboard options
init.description: Polling of PromQL sensors / alerts and the shared query cache.

data.scan_interval: Polling interval for sensors and alerts

data_description.scan_interval: How often PromQL sensors and the alerts sensor are updated
data_description.cache_ttl: Identical queries from cards, tabs and sensors within this time share one request to Prometheus. 0 disables the cache (concurrent requests are still merged)
data_description.alerts_enabled: Sensor with the number of firing alerts; the alert list is in its attributes

user.title: PromQL sensor
user.description: The query is executed before saving. If it returns several series they are combined with the selected aggregation; all series are available in the attributes.

data_description.query: Instant query, e.g. node_load1 or sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))

reconfigure.title: PromQL sensor
reconfigure.description: The query is executed before saving.

error.empty_result: The query returned no series. Check the metric name and label filters.

unreachable.title: Prometheus server {name} is unreachable
unreachable.description:
PromQL sensors and alerts of **{name}** cannot be updated: {error}

Check that the server is running, or change the connection with **Reconfigure** on the integration page. This message disappears automatically when the server answers again.
